summary: leanEthereum 宣布多个团队达成 pq-devnet-2，leanCL 客户端已通过 leanVM 聚合后量子签名。VitalikButerin 称 2026 年要夺回计算自主权，并分享自己换用的开源加密软件。donnoh_eth 提醒 dYdX v3 关停 452 天后用户仍能自行退出，因其是通过“离场测试”的 Stage 1 Rollup。

summary_en: leanEthereum said several teams reached pq-devnet-2, with leanCL clients now aggregating post-quantum signatures through leanVM. VitalikButerin said 2026 is the year to take back computing self sovereignty and shared the open source encrypted tools he switched to. donnoh_eth noted dYdX v3 users can still exit 452 days after shutdown because it is a Stage 1 rollup that passes the walkaway test.
